ValidationRule.description: Fields should be mandatory for Get Help and Get Help Appointment RT when status moved to Complete or Referred
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, !ISNEW(), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Complete'), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c , 'Evaluation Completed') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Referred'), OR( ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, 'Compliance Review'), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, 'Other') ) ) ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Get_Help', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Get_Help_Appointment' ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Evaluation_Type__c, 'Appointment'), ISPICKVAL(Evaluation_Type__c, 'Simple') ), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Connection_and_Trust__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Discover_and_Align__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Actions_and_Momentum__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Accountability_and_Next_Steps__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Energy_and_Adaptability__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select values for all required fields—Connection and Trust, Discover and Align, Actions and Momentum, Accountability and Next Steps, and Energy and Adaptability—before marking the application to Evaluation Completed.
